history.content: Hi, my phone has no service at all—no bars, nothing loads, and I can't send picture messages. It's completely dead as far as the network goes.

I can help you troubleshoot this issue. First, I need to identify your account to check for any line or account problems. Could you please provide your phone number, customer ID, or your full name and date of birth?
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Your line is currently suspended, which is why you have no service and cannot send picture messages. However, I see that your recent bills are paid, and your contract is still active.

Since your bills are up to date and your contract hasn't ended, I can resume your line to restore service. After I do this, you will need to reboot your device to regain network connectivity.

Would you like me to proceed and resume your line now?
Yes, please go ahead and resume my line.

Your line has been resumed and is now active. Please reboot your device to restore your network service. After restarting, you should be able to make calls, use data, and send picture messages again.

If you still experience any issues after rebooting, let me know and I can help you further troubleshoot.

history.content: My device rebooted successfully, but I still have no service. I checked the network status and it says airplane mode is on, signal strength is none, and network type is none.

Your phone is currently in Airplane Mode, which disables all wireless connections, including cellular service. To restore service, please turn off Airplane Mode on your device.

Once Airplane Mode is off, check if you regain signal bars and network connectivity. If you still have issues after turning it off, let me know and I’ll help you further troubleshoot.
Airplane mode is now OFF, but I still have no signal—no bars at all, and nothing is loading.

Thank you for turning off Airplane Mode. Since you still have no signal, the next step is to check your SIM card status. Sometimes, the SIM card may not be properly seated or recognized, which can cause a complete loss of service.

Please check your SIM card status on your device. If it shows as missing or not detected, try removing and reinserting (reseating) your SIM card. Let me know what your device reports for the SIM card status, or if you need guidance on how to reseat the SIM card.
My SIM card is detected and shows as active. I still have no service—no bars or network connection. What should I do next?

Since your SIM card is detected and active, but you still have no service, the next step is to check your network mode settings. Sometimes, if your phone is set to use an older network type (like 2G or 3G only), it may not connect if those networks are unavailable in your area.

Please check your network mode preference on your device. If it is set to 2G or 3G, change it to “4G/5G preferred” or a similar option that includes 4G or 5G. After changing this setting, see if your phone regains signal.

Let me know what your current network mode is, or if you need help changing this setting.
My network mode is already set to 4G/5G preferred, but I still have no signal or network connection.

Thank you for confirming your network mode is set correctly. Since your SIM card is active, Airplane Mode is off, and your network mode is set to 4G/5G preferred, but you still have no signal, the next step is to reseat your SIM card. This can resolve temporary connection issues even if the SIM appears active.

Please remove your SIM card from your device, wait a few seconds, and then reinsert it securely. After doing this, check if your phone regains signal.

Let me know if this helps or if you still have no service after reseating the SIM card.
I already removed and reinserted my SIM card. The SIM status shows as active, but there’s still no service or signal bars on my phone.

Thank you for confirming that you have already reseated your SIM card and that it shows as active, but you still have no service or signal bars. Since all standard troubleshooting steps (Airplane Mode, SIM status, network mode, and reseating the SIM) have been completed and your line is active, this may indicate a more complex technical issue.

I will transfer you to a human agent for further assistance, as this issue requires advanced troubleshooting beyond what I can provide.

YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.
